summary.title: The Heart of the Facility
summary.synopsis: The party continues exploring the bronze steampunk ruin embedded in an underground lava river, seeking to rescue Damien, a trapped human mercenary communicating through facility cameras. They discover a divine-like power source, debate trust and morality with two sentient orbs, and begin repairing the facility's piping system to open a locked door — each repair raising both the lava level and the stakes as Damien warns that further restoration will attract hostile entities.
key_beats: Josh distributes stat blocks for the Aegisfur crossbow and black Aeon Stone disc picked up previously; the party reviews their extensive inventory of resistance-granting items and Aeon Stones.

The party enters a large lava-bridge room with red hazmat-suited worker drones doing repairs. Perception checks reveal the drones are non-reactive biological constructs maintaining the facility's piping.

Divex identifies the facility's central power source via occultism (roll of 40) — it has a divine-like energy signature similar to Halia, Tenno's Orb, Savik, and Beast, but on a much smaller scale. Schism offers to analyze it as a potential catalyst for creating hearts/beacons.

A debate unfolds about whether to leave Schism with the artifact. Saran (another sentient orb) comments critically on the Sundom's morality — genocide and repeated life-death cycles — while acknowledging the Brokers as a net good. Lev pushes to keep Schism involved rather than leaving him behind, earning Schism's favoritism.

Henrik uses the eyeglass to identify the locked door's mechanism: a glass tube on the doorframe must be filled with bluish-purplish liquid by repairing four broken pipe subsystems. Don uses the Aegisfur crossbow to clear volatile magical energy blockages in the pipes.

Each pipe repair fills the tube further, activates dormant machinery (conveyor belts, grappling armatures cracking cooled lava rocks), and raises the lava level incrementally. Greenish-yellow sparks transfer from cracked rocks to the spinning heart artifact.

The party harvests approximately 600 meters of Hepatian metal — a copper-gold-silver alloy with extremely high magical conductivity — from the worker drones. Divex uses Detect Metal to identify its properties and potential for magic-transmitting wiring.
Schism is placed onto the spinning heart artifact to analyze it in depth, rotating with it like an unbalanced load in a dryer.

After three of four pipe repairs, Damien urgently warns that further power restoration will attract the hostile black-suited entities that captured him. He opens the gate and raises the bridge as an escape route, urging the party to flee and return with help.

Lev uses Recall Knowledge (roll of 40) on the worker drones: they are biological constructs similar to the Morning Light Endless Chasm fungal hive mind, with programmed if-then behavior, regenerative musculature, and room for a piloting intelligence. He exploits vulnerability, learning their highest resistance is 14 damage resistance to all damage except force, spirit, vitality, and ghost touch.

The party decides to press forward and rescue Damien rather than retreat, despite the imminent threat of hostile entities and rising lava. Tanner (Henrik's player) departs due to a family emergency, and the session ends before the confrontation begins.
characters_present: Damien (trapped human mercenary NPC, from Noxfell)
locations: Bronze steampunk ruin facility embedded in an underground lava river
Lava-bridge room with power source/heart artifact and locked door mechanism
items: Aegisfur crossbow (disruption weapon, no reload time in anticyclic framework areas)
The eyeglass (highlights interactable objects in correct order)
Hepatian metal foil (~600 meters, copper-gold-silver alloy, high magical conductivity)
Central power source / heart artifact (divine-like energy, spinning, potential catalyst)
Three Aeon Stones orbiting Lev's head
summary.cliffhanger: The party has chosen to press forward to rescue Damien despite his warning that restoring full power will attract hostile black-suited entities. The lava is rising with each repair, the heart artifact spins faster with Schism aboard it, and only one more pipe repair is needed to open the door — but doing so will trigger the encounter.
